description: Capability taxonomy aligned to the 13 DecisionPivot Core 1.1 task families. `other` is used when a training item does not exercise a close analogue of any Core family.

answerable_facts.description: Decide whether the supplied facts contain enough information to answer a question; includes lookup, inheritance, comparison, aggregation and missing-evidence chains.

perm_inherit.description: Resolve access or action permission through assignments, groups, resource hierarchy, role/action inheritance, denies and seals.

policy_case.description: Apply ordered policy clauses to a case, including precedence, exceptions and threshold boundaries, to choose approve/deny/escalate or an analogous decision.

log_count_check.description: Verify a stated count against event or log records under level, service and time-window filters, including boundary handling.

sched_conflict.description: Judge whether a proposed schedule or booking is feasible given overlaps, attendees, operating hours, capacity, equipment or multi-day constraints.

state_goal.description: Judge whether an action sequence reaches a requested goal and final state, including missing, swapped or wrong steps and content/count/equality conditions.

toolcall_valid.description: Validate a structured tool or function call against its schema and cross-field rules.

triage_order.description: Rank or select cases according to priority rules, flags, arrival/order/time and queue-position tie breakers.

clause_change.description: Determine how changing a contractual or policy clause changes the outcome for a fixed case.

dep_resolve.description: Resolve package, component or software dependencies under version bounds, missing requirements, runtime requirements and conflicts.

ledger_reconcile.description: Reconcile ledgers, transactions or batch totals and identify missing, amount, sign, date, split, fee or total discrepancies.

record_rule.description: Validate structured records against field and batch rules such as derived fields, references, ranges, uniqueness, XOR presence, conditionals and sequence constraints.

filter_match.description: Check whether one record satisfies every condition in a multi-constraint search or filtering request.

other.description: No close DecisionPivot Core analogue; use this instead of forcing an unrelated classification, generation, sentiment, open-domain QA or rubric task into a Core family.
